blocks.title: Radiant flux intensity
blocks.text: Radiant flux intensity, F, sitare ki woh electromagnetic tawanai hai jo fi ikai raqba fi ikai waqt zameen ki satah (ya sitare se d faasle par kisi nuqte) tak pohanchti hai. Yeh kul luminosity ka chhota hissa hai.

d faasle wale sitare ke liye radiant flux intensity F = L / (4 pi d^2) (21.2) hai, jahan L luminosity hai. Kyunke sitare ki luminosity constant hai, radiant flux intensity faasle ke saath inverse-square qanoon ki pairvi karti hai (Fig 21.1): sitare se faasla dugna (r se 2r) karne par shiddat aik chauthai reh jati; teen guna faasle par nau guna kam, waghera.

blocks.title: 4 pi d^2 kya hai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke F = L/(4 pi r^2) mein '4 pi r^2 sitare ki satah ka raqba hai'. Yahan nasab-numa d radius (sitare se dekhne wale tak faasla) ke khayali gole ka raqba hai, jis par sitare ki taqat phail gayi hai; yeh sitare ki apni satah ka raqba nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen sitara phailte cone mein roshni bhejta. r, 2r aur 3r faasle par wahi shua 1, 4 aur 9 chhote chaukoron mein bate raqbon se guzarti, F, F/4 aur F/9 likha. Neeche: F = L/(4 pi d^2); standard candles (Cepheid variables, Type Ia supernovae) ki luminosity maloom hai, is liye F naap kar d = sqrt(L/4 pi F).
blocks.caption: Inverse-square qanoon aur standard candles (Figs 21.1 aur 21.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Wahi taqat aise raqbe par phailti hai jo faasle ke square ke saath barhta hai, is liye har square metre ko kam milti hai. Standard candle ki kharij taqat jaan kar naapa gaya flux batata hai ke woh kitna door hai.

blocks.text: Aik sitare ki luminosity 4.50 x 10^26 W hai. Yeh aik sayyare se 1.40 x 10^11 m door hai. Sayyare ki satah par radiant flux intensity maloom karein. Hal: F = L / (4 pi r^2) = 4.50 x 10^26 W / (4 x 3.14 x (1.40 x 10^11 m)^2) = 1.83 x 10^3 W m^-2.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Agar zameen Sooraj se dugne faasle par hoti to us tak pohanchne wali dhoop sirf aik chauthai shiddat ki hoti; itni kam tawanai shayad zindagi ka irtiqa na-mumkin bana deti.

blocks.prompt: Do sitare raat ke aasman mein barabar roshan nazar aate hain, lekin aik doosre se 10 guna door hai. Kaun zyada luminous hai, aur kitna?
blocks.explanation: Door wala sitara: barabar F ke liye L, d^2 ke mutanasib hai, is liye yeh 10^2 = 100 guna zyada luminous hai.

items: F = L / (4 pi d^2): d faasle par fi ikai raqba taqat.
Inverse-square qanoon: dugna faasla, chauthai flux.
